key_insight: EliteReplay improves RL post-training for LLMs by combining GRPO with a quality-diverse replay archive, boosting accuracy while preserving multiple correct solution strategies.
engineering_relevance: For verifiable tasks like text-to-SQL, it offers a practical way to make post-trained models both more accurate and less single-solution biased, which matters for robust deployment on ambiguous inputs.
method: Use the frozen base model to sample solutions before training.
Build an "elite" archive via quality-diversity search to retain distinct correct approaches.
Train with GRPO plus a replay loss on the archived solutions to preserve diversity while improving performance.
evidence_signal: Across multiple text-to-SQL benchmarks, EliteReplay achieves the highest pass@128, up to 77% more distinct correct strategies than the strongest baselines, and nearly doubles coverage on ambiguous questions in AmbiQT.
watch_item: The archive-building and replay components add extra offline search and memory overhead, so gains may depend on task verifiability and careful implementation.
paper_title: EliteReplay: Preserving Diverse Solutions in RL Post-Training via Quality-Diversity Search
